Arthur Machen, The Hill of Dreams.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/arthur-machen/the-hill-of-dreams

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Arthur Machen, the author and writer of the preface, died 1947.

First publication of the text used: 1907, Grant Richards (United Kingdom) (Wikipedia gives the publication place as Wales, which is part of the United Kingdom). SE colophon: 'The Hill of Dreams was published in 1907 by Arthur Machen.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1907, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: copyright lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last person named above. The last to die did so in 1947, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 2018. The first publication (1907) was in the United Kingdom.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
